name: 愚者
upright: 全新的开始，怀着信任踏上未知的旅程。
reversed: 行事鲁莽或准备不足，需留意脚下的风险。
upright_en: A brand-new beginning: step into the unknown with trust.
reversed_en: Recklessness or lack of preparation; watch where you step.

name: 魔术师
upright: 具备将想法化为现实的能力与资源，主动出击的时机已到。
reversed: 才能被误用，或言行不一导致缺乏行动力。
upright_en: You have the ability and resources to turn ideas into reality. The time to take the initiative has come.
reversed_en: Talent misused, or a gap between words and actions leaves you without drive.

name: 女祭司
upright: 倾听直觉，答案往往藏在内在的静默之中。
reversed: 忽视内心的声音，或被隐藏的秘密所困惑。
upright_en: Listen to your intuition; the answer often hides in inner silence.
reversed_en: Ignoring your inner voice, or being confused by hidden secrets.

name: 皇后
upright: 丰盛与创造力涌现，滋养着身边的一切。
reversed: 创造力受阻，或过度付出而忽略了自己。
upright_en: Abundance and creativity flow, nourishing everything around you.
reversed_en: Creativity is blocked, or you give too much and neglect yourself.

name: 皇帝
upright: 以秩序与掌控力建立稳固的根基。
reversed: 过度专制独断，或既有的权威受到挑战。
upright_en: Build a solid foundation through order and control.
reversed_en: Overly tyrannical and rigid, or established authority is being challenged.

name: 教皇
upright: 遵循传统与既有的价值体系，从中获得指引。
reversed: 质疑常规教条，走出一条属于自己的路。
upright_en: Follow tradition and established values, and find guidance in them.
reversed_en: Question conventional dogma and forge a path of your own.

name: 恋人
upright: 心意相合的选择，关系与价值观趋于一致。
reversed: 关系失衡，或面临难以取舍的抉择。
upright_en: A choice made in harmony; relationships and values align.
reversed_en: A relationship out of balance, or a hard choice you can't decide on.

name: 战车
upright: 凭意志力与专注驾驭局面，勇往直前。
reversed: 方向失控，内耗让前进的脚步受阻。
upright_en: Steer the situation with willpower and focus, and push boldly ahead.
reversed_en: Direction slips out of control; inner conflict stalls your progress.

name: 力量
upright: 以温和而坚定的内在力量化解难题。
reversed: 自我怀疑，或压抑情绪而感到力不从心。
upright_en: Resolve difficulties with gentle yet steadfast inner strength.
reversed_en: Self-doubt, or suppressed emotions leave you feeling powerless.

name: 隐士
upright: 退居独处，向内探寻属于自己的答案。
reversed: 过度孤立，或逃避与外界的连接。
upright_en: Withdraw into solitude and look inward for your own answers.
reversed_en: Too isolated, or avoiding connection with the outside world.

name: 命运之轮
upright: 局势迎来转折，命运的齿轮开始转动。
reversed: 变化带来阻力，需顺势而为而非强求。
upright_en: A turning point arrives; the wheel of fate begins to turn.
reversed_en: Change brings resistance; go with the flow rather than forcing things.

name: 正义
upright: 以公正与理性权衡得失，因果自有回响。
reversed: 有失公允，或试图逃避应负的责任。
upright_en: Weigh gains and losses with fairness and reason; cause and effect will echo back.
reversed_en: Unfairness, or trying to dodge responsibility you owe.

name: 倒吊人
upright: 换个角度看待处境，暂缓行动反而豁然开朗。
reversed: 停滞不前，或牺牲流于徒劳。
upright_en: See your situation from a new angle; pausing action brings sudden clarity.
reversed_en: Stagnation, or a sacrifice that turns out to be futile.

name: 死神
upright: 一个阶段的终结，为新生腾出空间。
reversed: 抗拒必要的改变，旧模式难以放下。
upright_en: The end of one stage, making room for rebirth.
reversed_en: Resisting necessary change; old patterns are hard to let go.

name: 节制
upright: 调和对立的两极，在平衡中寻得和谐。
reversed: 失衡与过度，耐心正在被慢慢消耗。
upright_en: Blend opposing extremes and find harmony in balance.
reversed_en: Imbalance and excess; patience is slowly being worn down.

name: 恶魔
upright: 受困于欲望或恐惧编织的枷锁之中。
reversed: 开始挣脱束缚，重新夺回主导权。
upright_en: Trapped in shackles woven from desire or fear.
reversed_en: Beginning to break free and reclaim control.

name: 高塔
upright: 突如其来的变故，打破虚假的稳固。
reversed: 灾难得以避免，或延迟的崩塌终将到来。
upright_en: A sudden upheaval shatters false stability.
reversed_en: Disaster is averted, or a delayed collapse will still arrive.

name: 星星
upright: 风暴过后，希望与疗愈之光重新照亮前路。
reversed: 信心动摇，对未来感到迷茫。
upright_en: After the storm, the light of hope and healing shines on the road ahead again.
reversed_en: Confidence wavers and the future feels uncertain.

name: 月亮
upright: 潜意识与幻象交织，真相尚未明朗。
reversed: 迷雾渐散，隐藏的焦虑浮出水面。
upright_en: The subconscious and illusions intertwine; the truth is not yet clear.
reversed_en: The fog is lifting and hidden anxieties surface.

name: 太阳
upright: 明朗喜悦，成功与活力毫无保留地绽放。
reversed: 短暂的阴霾遮住了本该有的光彩。
upright_en: Bright joy; success and vitality bloom without reserve.
reversed_en: A brief cloud covers the glow that should be there.

name: 审判
upright: 回顾过往，迎来觉醒与重生的召唤。
reversed: 对自我或他人的评判过于苛刻。
upright_en: Look back on the past and answer the call to awakening and rebirth.
reversed_en: Judging yourself or others too harshly.

name: 世界
upright: 圆满完成一个循环，达成整合与成就。
reversed: 只差临门一脚，完成前仍有课题未解。
upright_en: A cycle comes to a full close, bringing integration and achievement.
reversed_en: Just one step short; unresolved lessons remain before completion.

name: 权杖一
upright: 新的灵感与行动力涌现，是放手一搏的好时机。
reversed: 计划迟迟无法启动，热情消退或方向不明。
upright_en: New inspiration and drive surge up; a good time to go all in.
reversed_en: The plan can't seem to get started; enthusiasm fades or direction is unclear.

name: 权杖二
upright: 站在十字路口，权衡未来的可能性与野心。
reversed: 犹豫不决错失良机，或视野过于狭隘。
upright_en: Standing at a crossroads, weighing future possibilities against ambition.
reversed_en: Indecision misses opportunities, or your vision is too narrow.

name: 权杖三
upright: 前期布局初见成效，视野开阔，机会正在扩展。
reversed: 计划受阻，扩张过快导致后继乏力。
upright_en: Early groundwork begins to pay off; your view widens and opportunities expand.
reversed_en: Plans are blocked; expanding too fast leaves you without follow-through.

name: 权杖四
upright: 阶段性的成果值得庆祝，家庭与团队关系稳固。
reversed: 根基不稳，庆祝被延后或内部出现分歧。
upright_en: Milestone results are worth celebrating; family and team bonds are solid.
reversed_en: Shaky foundations, a delayed celebration, or internal disagreements.

name: 权杖五
upright: 竞争与摩擦增多，需要在冲突中找到共识。
reversed: 逃避矛盾或内耗加剧，合作难以推进。
upright_en: Competition and friction increase; find common ground within the conflict.
reversed_en: Avoiding conflict or growing infighting makes cooperation hard.

name: 权杖六
upright: 努力得到认可，凯旋而归，声望上升。
reversed: 成果被质疑，或胜利只是暂时的。
upright_en: Your effort is recognized; a triumphant return and rising reputation.
reversed_en: Your results are questioned, or the victory is only temporary.

name: 权杖七
upright: 顶住压力坚守立场，在挑战中证明自己。
reversed: 疲于应付四面八方的压力，渐感力不从心。
upright_en: Hold your ground under pressure and prove yourself in the challenge.
reversed_en: Worn out by pressure from all sides and feeling powerless.

name: 权杖八
upright: 事情进展迅速，消息与行动接踵而至。
reversed: 计划延误，沟通出现误差或节奏被打乱。
upright_en: Things move fast; news and action come one after another.
reversed_en: Plans are delayed, communication goes wrong, or your rhythm is disrupted.

name: 权杖九
upright: 历经磨砺仍保持警觉，接近终点但不能松懈。
reversed: 身心俱疲，过度防备反而孤立了自己。
upright_en: Still alert after being tested; the finish line is near, but don't let up.
reversed_en: Exhausted in body and mind; too much defensiveness isolates you.

name: 权杖十
upright: 责任沉重，独自扛起了过多的任务。
reversed: 是时候放下负担，学会分担与取舍。
upright_en: The responsibility is heavy; you're carrying too many tasks alone.
reversed_en: Time to put the burden down and learn to share and prioritize.

name: 权杖侍从
upright: 怀着好奇心探索新领域，带来令人兴奋的消息。
reversed: 计划流于空想，缺乏实际行动。
upright_en: Exploring a new field with curiosity, bringing exciting news.
reversed_en: Plans stay daydreams with no real action.

name: 权杖骑士
upright: 冲劲十足，勇于追逐目标但略显冲动。
reversed: 行事鲁莽或半途而废，缺乏耐心。
upright_en: Full of drive and bold in chasing goals, though a bit impulsive.
reversed_en: Reckless or giving up halfway, lacking patience.

name: 权杖皇后
upright: 自信独立，用热情感染身边的人。
reversed: 过度强势或缺乏安全感，情绪起伏大。
upright_en: Confident and independent, inspiring those around you with passion.
reversed_en: Overbearing or insecure, with big emotional swings.

name: 权杖国王
upright: 具备远见与领导力，能将愿景付诸实践。
reversed: 专断固执，或空有野心却难以落地。
upright_en: Has vision and leadership, able to turn a vision into practice.
reversed_en: Domineering and stubborn, or ambitious but unable to make it real.

name: 圣杯一
upright: 情感的泉源涌现，新的爱意或灵性连接开始。
reversed: 情感受阻，内心空虚或错失表达的时机。
upright_en: A wellspring of emotion rises; new love or a spiritual connection begins.
reversed_en: Emotions are blocked; inner emptiness or a missed chance to express yourself.

name: 圣杯二
upright: 心意相通，一段关系走向和谐与承诺。
reversed: 关系失衡，误解让彼此渐行渐远。
upright_en: Hearts in tune; a relationship moves toward harmony and commitment.
reversed_en: A relationship out of balance; misunderstandings pull you apart.

name: 圣杯三
upright: 与朋友共享喜悦，友情与团聚带来滋养。
reversed: 社交流于表面，或群体中出现小摩擦。
upright_en: Sharing joy with friends; friendship and gatherings nourish you.
reversed_en: Socializing stays on the surface, or small frictions arise in the group.

name: 圣杯四
upright: 陷入沉思而忽略眼前的机会，略显冷漠。
reversed: 重新打开心扉，开始留意被忽视的可能性。
upright_en: Lost in contemplation and overlooking the opportunity in front of you, a bit aloof.
reversed_en: Opening your heart again and noticing possibilities you'd overlooked.

name: 圣杯五
upright: 沉溺于失落之中，却忽略了仍然拥有的部分。
reversed: 开始释怀，学着从遗憾中走出来。
upright_en: Wallowing in loss while ignoring what you still have.
reversed_en: Starting to let go and learning to move on from regret.

name: 圣杯六
upright: 怀旧的温情，与过去或纯真美好重新连接。
reversed: 过度依恋过去，难以面对当下的成长。
upright_en: Nostalgic warmth; reconnecting with the past or with innocence and beauty.
reversed_en: Too attached to the past, struggling to face present growth.

name: 圣杯七
upright: 选择太多让人眼花缭乱，需理清真正想要的。
reversed: 看清幻象，作出务实而清醒的决定。
upright_en: So many choices they dazzle you; sort out what you truly want.
reversed_en: Seeing through illusions and making a practical, clear-headed decision.

name: 圣杯八
upright: 放下已有的安逸，去追寻更深层的意义。
reversed: 犹豫是否离开，害怕未知而原地踏步。
upright_en: Leaving behind familiar comfort to seek deeper meaning.
reversed_en: Hesitating over whether to leave, staying put out of fear of the unknown.

name: 圣杯九
upright: 心愿得偿，享受满足与安逸的时刻。
reversed: 表面满足实则空虚，或有些自满。
upright_en: A wish fulfilled; enjoy a moment of contentment and comfort.
reversed_en: Seemingly satisfied but actually empty, or a bit complacent.

name: 圣杯十
upright: 情感圆满，家庭与关系带来长久的幸福。
reversed: 理想与现实有落差，家庭关系出现裂痕。
upright_en: Emotional fulfillment; family and relationships bring lasting happiness.
reversed_en: A gap between ideal and reality; cracks in family relationships.

name: 圣杯侍从
upright: 怀着纯真的心去感受与表达情感，充满想象力。
reversed: 情绪化或不成熟，耽于幻想。
upright_en: Feeling and expressing emotion with an innocent heart, full of imagination.
reversed_en: Emotional or immature, lost in fantasy.

name: 圣杯骑士
upright: 浪漫地追随内心，带着理想主义前行。
reversed: 三心二意，承诺难以兑现。
upright_en: Romantically following your heart, moving forward with idealism.
reversed_en: Wavering, with promises hard to keep.

name: 圣杯皇后
upright: 温柔体贴，善于共情并滋养他人。
reversed: 情绪过度敏感，容易被他人影响。
upright_en: Gentle and considerate, good at empathizing with and nurturing others.
reversed_en: Overly sensitive and easily swayed by others.

name: 圣杯国王
upright: 情感成熟稳重，能理性地驾驭内心波澜。
reversed: 情绪压抑或喜怒无常，难以真诚相待。
upright_en: Emotionally mature and steady, able to rationally steer inner turbulence.
reversed_en: Repressed or moody emotions make sincerity difficult.

name: 宝剑一
upright: 思路豁然开朗，真相或突破性的想法浮现。
reversed: 思维混乱，沟通被误解或判断有失偏颇。
upright_en: Your thinking suddenly clears; truth or a breakthrough idea emerges.
reversed_en: Muddled thinking, misunderstood communication, or skewed judgment.

name: 宝剑二
upright: 陷入两难，回避抉择只会让僵局持续。
reversed: 犹豫过久导致局势失控，需正视问题。
upright_en: Caught in a dilemma; avoiding the decision only prolongs the stalemate.
reversed_en: Hesitating too long lets things spiral; face the problem.

name: 宝剑三
upright: 心痛与失落袭来，但也是释放情绪的时刻。
reversed: 伤痛开始愈合，或旧伤被重新揭开。
upright_en: Heartache and loss hit, but it's also a time to release emotion.
reversed_en: The pain begins to heal, or an old wound is reopened.

name: 宝剑四
upright: 暂停脚步，给身心一段休整与恢复的时间。
reversed: 被迫重新投入战斗，休息尚未充分。
upright_en: Pause and give your body and mind time to rest and recover.
reversed_en: Forced back into the fight before you've rested enough.

name: 宝剑五
upright: 争执带来的胜利只是表面，代价不小。
reversed: 尝试和解，放下无谓的争斗与执念。
upright_en: A victory won through quarrel is only superficial and costs a lot.
reversed_en: Try to reconcile and let go of pointless fighting and fixation.

name: 宝剑六
upright: 离开纷扰之地，驶向更平静的境地。
reversed: 迟迟无法脱身，旧问题反复纠缠。
upright_en: Leave the chaos behind and sail toward calmer waters.
reversed_en: Unable to get away; old problems keep tangling you up.

name: 宝剑七
upright: 悄悄行动或另辟蹊径，但需留意诚信问题。
reversed: 策略败露，或良心不安促使坦白。
upright_en: Acting quietly or taking another route, but watch out for questions of integrity.
reversed_en: Your strategy is exposed, or a guilty conscience pushes you to confess.

name: 宝剑八
upright: 感觉被困住，其实束缚多来自内心的限制。
reversed: 开始挣脱思维的牢笼，重获自由。
upright_en: Feeling trapped, though the restraints mostly come from inner limits.
reversed_en: Beginning to break out of the cage of your thoughts and regain freedom.

name: 宝剑九
upright: 忧虑与失眠困扰，负面想法在夜里被放大。
reversed: 走出焦虑的低谷，重新看见希望。
upright_en: Troubled by worry and sleeplessness; negative thoughts grow louder at night.
reversed_en: Climbing out of the low point of anxiety and seeing hope again.

name: 宝剑十
upright: 局面跌至谷底，但也意味着旧模式的终结。
reversed: 挣扎着复原，最坏的时刻已经过去。
upright_en: Rock bottom, but also the end of an old pattern.
reversed_en: Struggling to recover; the worst moment has passed.

name: 宝剑侍从
upright: 保持警觉与好奇，渴望学习新的观点。
reversed: 言语鲁莽或消息不实，需多加求证。
upright_en: Staying alert and curious, eager to learn new perspectives.
reversed_en: Careless words or false news; verify more.

name: 宝剑骑士
upright: 果断迅速地行动，直奔目标而去。
reversed: 行事冲动鲁莽，缺乏周全的考虑。
upright_en: Acting decisively and quickly, heading straight for the goal.
reversed_en: Impulsive and reckless, without thorough consideration.

name: 宝剑皇后
upright: 清晰理智，凭独立思考看穿表象。
reversed: 言辞尖锐或过于冷漠，疏离他人。
upright_en: Clear-minded and rational, seeing through appearances with independent thought.
reversed_en: Sharp words or excessive coldness push others away.

name: 宝剑国王
upright: 逻辑严谨，以公正的判断力主导局面。
reversed: 滥用权威或过度苛刻，缺乏温度。
upright_en: Rigorous in logic, leading the situation with fair judgment.
reversed_en: Abusing authority or being too harsh, lacking warmth.

name: 星币一
upright: 实际的机会出现，是稳步开始的好兆头。
reversed: 机会被错过，或计划缺乏落地的基础。
upright_en: A practical opportunity appears, a good omen for a steady start.
reversed_en: An opportunity is missed, or the plan lacks a foundation to land on.

name: 星币二
upright: 在多项事务间寻求平衡，灵活应对变化。
reversed: 顾此失彼，资源调配出现失衡。
upright_en: Seeking balance among multiple matters and adapting flexibly to change.
reversed_en: Neglecting one thing for another; resources are unevenly allocated.

name: 星币三
upright: 携手协作打磨作品，专业能力获得认可。
reversed: 团队配合不佳，标准难以达成一致。
upright_en: Collaborating to refine the work, with your professional skill recognized.
reversed_en: Poor teamwork; standards can't be agreed on.

name: 星币四
upright: 稳固地守住已有的成果，但也略显保守。
reversed: 过度执着于安全感，害怕付出与改变。
upright_en: Firmly holding on to what you have, though a bit conservative.
reversed_en: Too attached to security, afraid of giving or changing.

name: 星币五
upright: 经历物质或精神上的困顿，感到被孤立。
reversed: 情况开始好转，援助正在靠近。
upright_en: Going through material or spiritual hardship and feeling isolated.
reversed_en: Things begin to improve and help is drawing near.

name: 星币六
upright: 施与受达成平衡，慷慨带来良性循环。
reversed: 给予或接受失衡，帮助附带了条件。
upright_en: Giving and receiving are in balance; generosity creates a healthy cycle.
reversed_en: Giving or receiving is unbalanced; help comes with strings attached.

name: 星币七
upright: 停下来评估投入的成果，耐心等待收获。
reversed: 努力尚未见效，容易心生放弃的念头。
upright_en: Pause to assess the results of your investment and wait patiently for the harvest.
reversed_en: Effort hasn't paid off yet, and thoughts of giving up creep in.

name: 星币八
upright: 专注打磨技艺，脚踏实地积累实力。
reversed: 敷衍了事或缺乏动力，进度停滞。
upright_en: Focused on honing your craft and building strength step by step.
reversed_en: Half-hearted or unmotivated; progress stalls.

name: 星币九
upright: 凭自己的努力获得独立与富足。
reversed: 过度追求物质而忽略了内心的满足。
upright_en: Independence and abundance earned through your own effort.
reversed_en: Chasing material things while neglecting inner fulfillment.

name: 星币十
upright: 长久的积累带来家族与财富的传承。
reversed: 家庭财务出现纷争，根基受到动摇。
upright_en: Long accumulation brings a legacy of family and wealth.
reversed_en: Family financial disputes shake the foundation.

name: 星币侍从
upright: 脚踏实地学习新技能，对现实机会充满好奇。
reversed: 三分钟热度，计划缺乏耐心执行。
upright_en: Learning new skills steadily, curious about real-world opportunities.
reversed_en: A passing enthusiasm; the plan lacks patient execution.

name: 星币骑士
upright: 稳扎稳打地推进目标，讲求效率与责任。
reversed: 进度停滞不前，或过于墨守成规。
upright_en: Advancing toward goals steadily, valuing efficiency and responsibility.
reversed_en: Progress stalls, or you cling too rigidly to routine.

name: 星币皇后
upright: 务实且体贴，善于经营生活与资源。
reversed: 过度操劳或忽略了自我照顾。
upright_en: Practical and caring, good at managing life and resources.
reversed_en: Overworked, or neglecting self-care.

name: 星币国王
upright: 稳健可靠，以务实的态度成就丰盛。
reversed: 过分看重物质，或固执于掌控一切。
upright_en: Steady and reliable, achieving abundance through a practical attitude.
reversed_en: Overvaluing the material, or stubbornly clinging to control.
